newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends lower on speculative profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends lower on speculative profit-taking.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended lower Tuesday, under pressure from year-end profit taking by speculators, CBOT pit traders said.
"I suspect we were also a little overbought," said one pit trader.
CBOT rice futures scored fresh contract highs last week.
The November and September contracts were under pressure from hedge selling, while LIT was a a buyer of new crop contracts, pit traders said.
Deliveries against January contract were slightly heavier than expected and weighed on January, pit trader said.
The CBOT said 177 lots were delivered, versus trade expectations for 100 lots.
One technician said that March rice should find good support at 10.90 per cwt.
Rice futures volume was estimated by the CBOT at 500 contracts, below the 737 contracts traded Monday.
Rice closed 8 to 9 cents per cwt lower, with January down 9 at $11.03 per cwt.
